# NBN Design

> NBN Design is an independent Australian consultancy that prepares NBN pit and pipe designs for single dwelling unit (SDU) and multi dwelling unit (MDU) developments, Australia-wide. Designs are prepared by NBN trained Pit and Pipe and Pathway designers. Pricing is per unit and falls as a project grows: $120 per unit for 1 to 10 units, $108 for 11 to 25, $95 for 26 to 50, $82 for 51 to 100 and $70 from 101 units. Plans are turned around within two weeks of receiving complete CAD plans. NBN Design is not affiliated with or endorsed by NBN Co Limited.

## Services
- [SDU pit and pipe design](https://nbndesign.net/sdu-pit-and-pipe-design): stand-alone lots, duplexes and triplexes; one lead-in conduit per premises.
- [MDU pit and pipe design](https://nbndesign.net/mdu-pit-and-pipe-design): apartment buildings and horizontal MDUs.
